main_text.p: æquari, nihil comparari poffit, vt quæ toto genere ab eis differât, & res omnes humanas,quæ dici aut cogitari poffunt, maximopere antecellant: excitemur per Deum immortalem ex illo infausto lethiferoq. veterno , quo nos communisille aduerfarius falutis noftræ foporauit , & in quo nati,educati, alti conquiefcimus plus fatis. Videamus tandem nihil in rebus omnibus mundi exiftere , quod nobis verà excellentiam præbeat,quamuis oftentet fpeciem: nihil attendi à nobis oportere , ad quod (vt certatim) faciemus)apprehendendum concurramus in his labentibus. & caducis rebus: præterit enim figura 1.Cor.7.mundi huius,inquit Apoftolus.quin potiús pro eo quod ita miserè in fluxis rebus naturá noftrâ & ftudio diffluimus; veram excellentiam rerum quæramus ftudiofiffimè: veram doctrinam excellentiæ naturâ extinctam , fed gratiâ oblatam pereipiamus diligentiffimè: & verum auctorem doctrinæ huius ( cuius beneficio ad veritatem rerum doctrinarumque falutarium quàm indulgentiffimè prouocamur ) aufculte- mus religiofiffimè : & in fcholá eius hærentes, tamquam ad pedes ipfius, hauriamus de riuis veritatis,expectantes dum ad fontem illius pleniffimum pleniffimè perducamur.
Ex his itaque fontibus de cóhditione fanctæ pacis & Chriftianæ ductuti aliquos riuos ad communem ædificatiónem , Deum oramus vt nobis de ipfa excellentia dicturis ptæfit Spiritu

page.notes: The first line is cut at the left, so the page opens on a fragment; the first paragraph is marked cont="true". The word "poffunt" and "miserè" are read from a small scan and may be misprints for "possunt" and "miserè"; check them. The word "ptæfit" is read as printed. The small mark under the last line at the left (a possible gathering signature) is too faint to read and is left out. The ornament at the bottom centre is left out. The right edge shows the neighbouring page and is left out.
